policy.rule_literal_basis: cheapest passing policy on the 40-query reference subset (virtual CPU 6.34 s/query, 1/26 reference positives missed = 3.8%); adaptive_v1 virtual CPU ratio 1.175 > 1.15
why_recommended_differs: broad pilot (205 queries, reference label known for all via a disclosed post-hoc reference supplement on the 27 adaptive NEG_UNDER_POLICY queries): fixed_4x1500 misses 6/138 reference positives, all FAR destinations: far band 6/45 = 13.3% (Wilson 6.3-26.2%) > the rule's 10% stratum limit, which the 40-query subset could not evaluate (9 far reference positives < 10)
measured CPU ratio adaptive_v1 / fixed_4x1500 on the same 205 queries = 1.10, within the rule's own 1.15 adaptive-preference margin
adaptive_v1 is the predeclared broad-pilot policy and carries the full evidence (2 runs, serial, sweeps, interrupt, replays)
policy.label_semantics: 1 = a scheduled valid, physically held grasp unit passes all 13 MuJoCo verification gates; 0 = NEG_CERTIFIED_GEOMETRY or NEG_UNDER_POLICY (BOUNDED_SEARCH / EXECUTION / DETERMINISTIC_PLAN) with full mode accounting; unlabeled = static ineligible, NO_VALID_POST_GRASP_STATE, INTERRUPTED (never 0)

workers.cpu_mask: 0-11 (physical cores; SMT siblings 12-23 and >= 6 logical CPUs left free)
workers.rule: fastest; a config with fewer workers within 5% wins
